ConnectionStrings._comment: Intentionally EMPTY — never commit a connection string with credentials. Set CertDb via user-secrets, e.g. dotnet user-secrets set "ConnectionStrings:CertDb" "Server=localhost,1433;Database=CertExtraction;User Id=<user>;Password=<password>;TrustServerCertificate=True" --project SteelCertExtraction.csproj

Llm._comment: Provider: LiteLlm (corporate proxy -> Bedrock) or Anthropic (direct API). Values below are PLACEHOLDERS. Do NOT commit API keys — use user-secrets (Llm:LiteLlm:ApiKey / Llm:Anthropic:ApiKey) or environment variables (Llm__Anthropic__ApiKey).
